result.title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
result.summary: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? In MobileGym, we adjust each dimension separately, train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, and evaluate every policy in the original full environment. A verifier that rewards only one reference path lowers success by 10.53 points, and removing unneeded records also lowers success. Pruning unneeded features instead raises success from 51.61% to 56.13%, entirely on tasks whose environments it left unchanged. The gain reverses when each episode is weighted equally and vanishes when only episodes on the pruned tasks are balanced. Without pruning, length weighting there reinforces long detour successes that erode skills on other tasks. Following these findings, we build MobileGym-Lite, which keeps reward and data coverage complete and prunes unneeded features. It outperforms Full in the full environment (55.48% versus 51.61% success) with lower construction cost.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 MobileGym 中沿奖励覆盖、数据覆盖与功能覆盖三个维度分别调节环境完整度，训练 Qwen3-VL-4B 并在原完整环境中评估，发现只奖励单一参考路径会显著降低成功率、剪除冗余功能反而提升（但增益依赖回合加权方式），据此构建精简版 MobileGym-Lite。
AI.relevance_reason: 其奖励覆盖与路径级验证器设计、以及按长度加权的轨迹监督偏差，可供核查 LVR 中轨迹贡献分配与验证器设计问题；功能与数据覆盖的受控消融也可能为「任务必要视觉信息是否必须保留」提供实验框架。
